Opposition Protests Demand Chief Election Commissioner's Ouster

The National Students' Union of India (NSUI) protested at India Gate, demanding the ouster and arrest of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). INDIA bloc parties announced a 'Save Democracy' rally in Jammu on October 7, also demanding the CEC's removal. The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), led by Vijay, is set to join an INDIA bloc meeting seeking the removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
